//: Copy this to appsettings.Production.json on the server ONLY. It is gitignored for a reason: every value below is a secret. Upload it once by FTP; the deploy workflow never overwrites it.

ConnectionStrings.//: From the MyASP.NET control panel > MySQL databases. Keep SslMode as the host requires it.

Database.//: Leave AutoMigrate true for the first deploy so the schema is created, then consider turning it off so a deploy can never alter the schema unattended.
Database.//AutoSeed: Creates the first administrator and reference data. Turn OFF after the first successful start.

Jwt.//: Generate a fresh key. Anyone holding it can mint valid tokens for any user. 64+ random characters, never reused between environments: openssl rand -base64 64

Seed.//: Used once, on the very first start. Change this password immediately after signing in.

SchoolTime.//: Windows timezone id. Attendance lateness and the daily rollover are computed in this zone, so getting it wrong shifts every arrival time.

RfidDevices.//: Readers exchange this once for their own key. Rotate it after the gateways are enrolled.

FileStorage.//: Outside wwwroot so uploaded files are never served directly by IIS, and excluded from deploys so they survive.

Cors.//: The SPA is same-origin, so this list can stay empty unless the Flutter app or another front end calls the API from a different host.
